summary.name: Stephen Thorne's Medium blog (jerub)
summary.one_liner: Medium profile page for Stephen Thorne (@jerub), listed as a blog about SRE, but the captured page only shows a Cloudflare block message, so its content is unknown.
use_cases: browsing a curated list of sre writers
summary.what_it_does: The page captured here is a Cloudflare security block message ("Sorry, you have been blocked") rather than the author's blog content. It says the request was stopped by a website security service, possibly due to a word or phrase, SQL-like command, or malformed data. It invites the visitor to email the site owner with the Cloudflare Ray ID. No articles, topics, or posts are visible on this page.
caveats: The captured page is a block message, so the blog's actual content could not be verified
Access was blocked by Cloudflare security on this visit
